content.short: Syndicate DAO enables groups of people to pool capital and invest in web3 projects they believe.
content.description: Syndicate is a social network and decentralized investing protocol that enables investors and communities to create Web3-native investing DAOs. It provides infrastructure and tools for DAOs to network socially, invest in the real world, and stay compliant. With on-chain operations, distributions are automatically managed by smart contracts. Syndicate also helps limit the personal liability of investment DAO members by enabling DAOs to connect to LLCs and other real-world capabilities in a compliant manner.
content.meta: Syndicate DAO is a social network and decentralized investing protocol for Web3-native DAOs. Discover Syndicate DAO and other DAOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
